newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Port conditions update - S.Korea - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - S.Korea - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

SOUTH KOREA, Feb 27 - Busan - 175 Vessels in port, 68 at berth and 107 at anchorage. Delay about three to four days. Ulsan - 65 Vessels in port, 25 at berth and 40 at anchorage. Delay about one to two days. Pohang - 41 Vessels in port, 30 at berth and 11 at anchorage, no delay. Inchon - 74 Vessels in port, 47 at berth and 27 at anchorage, delay about one to two days.
